sources.label: Federal Reserve Distributional Financial Accounts (US net worth shares)
ONS Wealth and Assets Survey, total wealth (Great Britain)

meta.notes: US: share of household net worth, Federal Reserve DFA (year-end). Verified anchors: Top 1% 22.8% (1989) -> 30.8% (2024); bottom 50% 3.5% (1990) -> 2.4% (2024). UK: share of total household wealth, ONS Wealth & Assets Survey by two-year wave (year shown is the wave end). Verified 2020-22: wealthiest 10% held 41%, least wealthy 50% held 9%; aggregate wealth £13.6 trillion. NOTE the US and UK figures are not directly comparable: ONS total wealth includes private pension and property wealth, which lowers measured UK concentration relative to the US DFA.
